content:
I'm fairly new to Lean4 and haven't worked on anything more than 2-3 .lean files. Now I have this medium sized project found here:

https://github.com/FruitfulApproach/Lean4TPC

And all I'm getting from Lean4 is the spins (according to the InfoView), even on TPC/Basic.lean.

I'm not sure where this is stemming from, I ran "lake build TPC.Basic" without any errors, so, why can't it be stepped through? I need to learn some things about how to do things in Lean4, and I'm stepping through / hovering over code on some examples to read the data about the keyword etc, but currently none of that works, because of the infinite spinning.
Okay, spinning finally stopped and am getting info displayed. Just took all day. I have 16GB of ram on my system, so... ?
